stock.justification: The insert combines a stereo diffused FDN, interpolated dual-head octave shifting, eight-pole antialias filters, DC fractional carries and all-six-control smoothing. DARK REV supplies reverb without pitch feedback. Matched executed cost is 4.174 times DARK REV; tested support is two Shimmers/core with four DARK REVs on the remaining tracks and no FX1. The conservative split-stress figure also includes harness dispatch. Cost acceptance and first release remain subject to owner review.

stress.method: Combined actual evidence: direct DSP-host -dirty/-guard/-guard-shared stress at two/core plus native ColdFire/dual-DSP A01 project playback for 82688 frames. Shimmer T1/T2/T5/T6, DARK REV T3/T4/T7/T8, FX1 NONE. All 24 LFO destinations and 14-15 lock lanes/track varied in 162 live snapshots; shared verify_set returned zero failures. Only A01 ran. T2 TIME reserved unlocked for actual CC40=100 probe. No hardware, save/reload, physical reboot or arbitrary FX1/other-module load is claimed.
